moisturising body mousse

90% ingredients of natural origin

Moisturising lotion in the form of a fluffy mousse, frgranced with the scent of mango. Visibly moisturises the epidermis and firms the skin. Absorbs quickly, leaves the skin soft. Leaves a pleasant fragrance on the skin.

How to use

Massage the mousse into the skin and leave until fully absorbed. For very dry skin, use at least twice a day.

INCI

Aqua (Water), Isopropyl Myristate, Isononyl Isononanoate, Glycerin, Elaeis Guineensis (Palm) Oil, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG-100 Stearate, Propylene Glycol, Cetearyl Alcohol, Dimethicone, Ficus Carica (Fig) Fruit Extract, Hydrolyzed Glycosaminoglycans, Caffeine, Methylsilanol Mannuronate, Shorea Stenoptera Seed Butter, Sodium Polyacrylate Starch, Carbomer, Benzotriazolyl Dodecyl p-Cresol, Xanthan Gum, Phenoxyethanol, Methylparaben, Parfum (Fragrance), Hexyl Cinnamal, Linalool, Limonene, Citronellol, Citral, Amyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Sodium Hydroxide.

The list of ingredients is consistent with the current state of manufacture as of 2020-10.

MAIN INGREDIENTS

fig extract, Illipe butter, caffeine, alginic acid
